card.fires_on: Partway through biological family names such as Moraceae or Boraginaceae, and through language or taxon group names like Siouan or Curculionoidea. It also fires on 'the' just before such a group name after 'belongs to' or 'from'.

modes.label: Plant family endings
modes.description: Inside Latin plant family names, just before the -aceae ending is complete.

modes.label: Language or animal group names
modes.description: Inside or just before names of language branches and animal superfamilies.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'family', 'members', 'subclass' and 'category', which name a taxonomic group.
card.plain: It lights up while a family or group name is being spelled out, as in botany or language classification.
